description: This file implements a HungarianMatcher class used for computing optimal assignment between predicted objects and ground-truth targets in object detection tasks, with an additional utility function for constructing such matchers based on arguments.

classes.name: HungarianMatcher
classes.description: A PyTorch module that computes an optimal assignment between predicted object detections and ground-truth targets using the Hungarian algorithm with customizable cost weights.

methods.name: __init__(self, cost_class: float = 1, cost_bbox: float = 1, cost_giou: float = 1)
methods.description: Initializes the matcher with specified weights for classification, bounding box L1 loss, and GIoU loss.

methods.name: forward(self, outputs, targets)
methods.description: Performs the matching process by computing cost matrices based on classification scores, bounding box L1 distance, and GIoU, then applies the Hungarian algorithm to find optimal assignments.
